edges.label: Blue Book investigators knowingly issued false explanations for U-2 sightings
edges.note: CIA records that Blue Book investigators aware of the secret U-2 flights attributed sightings to ice crystals and temperature inversions and 'were careful, however, not to reveal the true cause of the sighting to the public.'

a.label: A Die-hard Issue: CIA's Role in the Study of UFOs, 1947-1990

edges.label: CIA refused declassification and issued a sanitised version of the Robertson Panel report
edges.note: CIA 'prepared a sanitized version of the report which deleted any reference to CIA and avoided mention of any psychological warfare potential in the UFO controversy.'

a.label: A Die-hard Issue: CIA's Role in the Study of UFOs, 1947-1990

edges.label: A documented precedent for institutional falsification about UFOs by the US Air Force
edges.note: CIA's own history establishes that the Air Force knowingly issued false UFO explanations for at least a decade. That precedent is why the YANKEE BLUE allegation cannot be dismissed on plausibility grounds alone.

edges.label: Moore admitted cooperating with AFOSI and passing disinformation to Bennewitz
edges.note: Moore told the 1989 MUFON symposium that he had worked with Air Force counterintelligence in exchange for access, and had knowingly fed Bennewitz false material.

edges.label: Moore controlled the MJ-12 material's release with Shandera and Friedman
edges.note: Moore and Shandera published 'The MJ-12 Documents: An Analytical Report' as Fair-Witness Project Publication 1500 in 1990, cited in CIA's own 1997 UFO history.
